messages:
Anya (Support): heads up — acme-inc on Private reporting debug bundle upload failing and redaction missing. customer found emails in the bundle. upload returned 403. request ids I pulled from their dashboard: rpt=01GCF2B9, upload_req=upload-0a7f. need repro steps and a clean bundle to hand back.
Sam (Platform): can you paste the collector log around the upload + the presign URL error? also which collector version are they on?
Anya (Support): they report collector v2.3.1. log excerpt:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z INFO  Collector v2.3.1 starting
2026-03-16T14:05:03Z INFO  preparing bundle debug-123.tar.gz
2026-03-16T14:06:12Z WARN  upload: presign PUT https://s3.internal/acme/debug-123.tar.gz -> 403
2026-03-16T14:06:12Z ERROR assume-role failed: token expired
2026-03-16T14:06:12Z INFO  request_id=upload-0a7f
2026-03-16T14:06:12Z INFO  bundle_path=/opt/collector/out/debug-123.tar.gz
```
Anya (Support): and example of in-bundle PII they reported (redacted here): `user.email: alice@example.com` — so redaction didn't run.
Leo (SRE): sounds like two issues: presign/credentials (403 + assume-role expired) and redaction config. which env vars were set in their helm values? if REDACT_LEVEL is wrong collector will skip transformations.
Anya (Support): checked their values.yaml: `collector.env.REDACT_LEVEL: "none"` — looks like a deploy mistake on their end.
Marta (Security): agree — we need to repro locally and produce a fully redacted bundle before returning to customer. recommended steps:
- set REDACT_LEVEL=full
- run collector generate (force) to recreate bundle
- reissue presign (the previous presign likely used expired STS creds)
Sam (Platform): repro commands (run from customer Private control plane/node where collector runs):
```
# regenerate with full redaction
export REDACT_LEVEL=full
/opt/collector/bin/collector generate --bundle-id debug-123 --force
# get new presign from control plane (API returns PUT URL)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://private-control.acme.internal/api/v1/debug-presign?bundle=debug-123" | jq -r .put_url > presign_url.txt
# upload via presign to test
curl -v -X PUT -T /opt/collector/out/debug-123.redacted.tar.gz "$(cat presign_url.txt)" -H "x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control"
```
Sam (Platform): how to extract request ids from logs quickly:
```
grep -E "request_id|upload_req|assume-role" /var/log/collector/*.log -n -A2
```
CollectorBot: Bundle generated: /opt/collector/out/debug-123.redacted.tar.gz size=4.2MB checksum=sha256:deadbeef
Anya (Support): I re-ran with REDACT_LEVEL=full and tried upload — still got 403. logs showed: `assume-role failed: request time too skewed` — customer VM clock was off by ~6 minutes.
Leo (SRE): fix clock (ntpd / chrony), re-issue STS token then regenerate presign. Common in Private when VMs not NTP-synced.
Anya (Support): synced NTP, requested new presign from control plane, re-upload succeeded. confirmed bundle no longer contains email addresses when inspected.
Marta (Security): quick verification steps for future:
- tar tvf bundle | head to check file list
- grep -E "[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}" -R /tmp/unpacked-bundle || true
- run our redaction-checker: `/opt/collector/bin/redaction-check --bundle /opt/collector/out/debug-123.redacted.tar.gz`
Sam (Platform): if presign path still blocked, fallback to secure jumpbox upload (scp/sftp):
```
scp /opt/collector/out/debug-123.redacted.tar.gz support@jumpbox.internal:/data/debugs/acme/
# or sftp interactively
sftp support@jumpbox.internal
> put debug-123.redacted.tar.gz /data/debugs/acme/
```
Anya (Support): used scp once as fallback while we sorted STS — note to support: ensure retention+access controls on jumpbox path.
Leo (SRE): followup actions:
- [Platform] add a pre-upload check to fail fast on clock skew (check |NTP offset| > 2min)
- [Support] advise customers to set REDACT_LEVEL in chart defaults; add a note to onboarding checklist
- [Security] add redaction-checker to collector release notes
Marta (Security): concur. I'll open a small policy ticket for onboarding doc update.
Anya (Support): customer happy, we handed over redacted bundle and confirmed upload. closing after doc updates. :thumbsup:
